   "The proposal allows data center customers to waive curtailment compensation to fulfill ratepayer protection pledges and excludes new large load from the VRR curve to protect residential customers.",
   "While the exclusion of new large load from the VRR curve could present downside risk to capacity prices over time, Goldman Sachs does not view this as a near-term concern.",
